appraisal_events.evidence: tous pensaient... « Il n'est pas positivement laid si vous voulez, mais il est ridicule; ce monocle, ce toupet, ce sourire! », réalisant... la démarcation immatérielle qui sépare... une tête d'amant de cœur et une tête de cocu
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator reports and clearly endorses society's shifted perception of Swann: his face, once read as that of a devoted lover, is now read by everyone as that of a ridiculous cuckold, a sharp local diminishment of his standing.

status_effects.explanation: Swann is now perceived by everyone as ridiculous, his very features reinterpreted as the visible marks of a deceived husband.
His eager, credulous seizing on Odette's ambiguous, half-mocking words for any pretext of hope shows continued dependency and vulnerability, consistent with his diminished position.
